name: Four Oaks Hill Farm
tagline: Four Oaks Hill Farm, 2181 High Hill Rd, Darlington, SC (2026)
description: In Darlington, SC, Four Oaks Hill Farm raises Blueberries and Grapes on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
